conceptual_change: Introduce a trailing stop-loss mechanism based on the 22-period Chandelier Exit with a 3.0x ATR multiplier for all BTCUSDT 1h long positions to replace the static stop-loss, maintaining existing entry triggers.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: Following the rejection of BC 7 due to implementation requirements, BC 8 formalizes the logic for the Chandelier Exit trailing stop to be integrated into the execution framework to mitigate downside risk relative to volatility as established in the baseline validation data.
